page.overview:
Who is Aldrhamar?

A master necrotect from the far city of Quatar, it was Aldrhamars duty to ensure that the ushabti were kept in good fighting order. To him were entrusted the Statuary of the Temple of Usirian and the ushabti unit, the Lions of the Sand.
